entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Pilot raised as Urza's son, who found Argoth and survived the Sylex Blast aboard a ship; later rumored a hero, and said by K'rrik to have become Phyrexian.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Raised Harbin as his son, though privately doubted it.

entities.name: Melana
entities.description: Harbin's wife, who stayed in the court of Penregon.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island Harbin found in 55 AR; site of the last battle of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Son of Harbin, one of the first great mages of the Dark Age.

entities.name: K'rrik
entities.description: Said Harbin turned into a Phyrexian.

events.summary: Harbin is born after the Siege of Kroog and builds his first glider by age six.
events.quote: He built his first glider by age six.

events.summary: In 55 AR Harbin finds the island of Argoth.
events.quote: Harbin found the island of Argoth

events.summary: Harbin's ship is struck by a wave from the Sylex Blast and he sees Argoth as a column of fire.
events.quote: Harbin saw to the south that Argoth was a red column of fire.

events.summary: Kayla assumes Harbin dead but later hears of a flying hero and resolves to cross the continent to learn the truth.
events.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth.

events.summary: K'rrik later states Harbin became a Phyrexian, though the truth is unclear.
events.quote: Harbin ended up turning into a Phyrexian

relations.quote: Harbin was the son of Kayla bin-Kroog

relations.note: raised as Urza's son, paternity uncertain
relations.quote: He was raised as Urza's son
Harbin was the father of Jarsyl
